class Control:
 def __init__(self,s=None):
  self.s=s or rcb_dtb.Session(); self.m=self.s.model; self.d=self.s.data; self.k=mujoco.MjData(self.m)
  self.b=self.m.body('palmleft_hand_C_MC').id; self.jp=np.zeros((3,self.m.nv)); self.jr=self.jp.copy()
  self.t=self.s.targets.copy()

 def ik(self,p,R,seed=None):
  q=self.t[:7].copy() if seed is None else seed.copy()
  self.k.qpos[:]=self.d.qpos
  for i in range(80):
   self.k.qpos[self.s._jq[:7]]=q; mujoco.mj_kinematics(self.m,self.k); mujoco.mj_comPos(self.m,self.k)
   err=np.r_[p-self.k.xpos[self.b],Rot.from_matrix(R@self.k.xmat[self.b].reshape(3,3).T).as_rotvec()]
   if np.linalg.norm(err)<1e-5: break
   mujoco.mj_jacBody(self.m,self.k,self.jp,self.jr,self.b)
   J=np.r_[self.jp[:,self.s._jv[:7]],self.jr[:,self.s._jv[:7]]]
   dq=J.T@np.linalg.solve(J@J.T+np.eye(6)*1e-5,err)
   q=np.clip(q+np.clip(dq,-.15,.15),self.s.lower[:7],self.s.upper[:7])
  return q
 def step(self,t=None):
  if t is not None:self.t=np.asarray(t).copy()
  return self.s.step(self.t)
 def hold(self,n):
  for _ in range(n):self.step()
 def move(self,p,R=None,n=120,hand=None):

  for i in range(n):
   u=(i+1)/n; u=u*u*(3-2*u)
   self.t[:7]=self.ik(p0+(p-p0)*u,Rot.from_rotvec(dr*u).as_matrix()@R0)
   self.t[7:]=h0+(hand-h0)*u; self.step()
 def image(self,name):Image.fromarray(self.s.render_grid(size=(640,480))).save('/app/output/'+name+'.png')
 def info(self,label):
  print(label,'step',self.s.steps,'obj',np.round(self.d.xpos[self.s._obj],4),'quat',np.round(self.d.xquat[self.s._obj],3),'hand',np.round(self.pose()[0],4),self.s.progress(),flush=True)
  cc=[]
